title: Metrics by Month (Real/LY/Δ/Target)
sql:
with params as (select '7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a'::uuid cid),
n_agg as (select extract(year from n.stay_date)::int y, extract(month from n.stay_date)::int m,
  sum(n.price) prodacc,
  sum(case when n.bed_code_raw is null or n.bed_code_raw='' then r.beds_per_room else 1 end) bn,
  count(distinct n.reservation_uid) res
  from nights n left join rooms r on r.company_id=n.company_id and r.raw_value=n.room_code_raw
  where n.company_id=(select cid from params) group by 1,2),
cap_agg as (select extract(year from rcc.date)::int y, extract(month from rcc.date)::int m, sum(r.beds_per_room) cap
  from room_capacity_calendar rcc join rooms r on r.id=rcc.room_id
  where rcc.company_id=(select cid from params) and rcc.status='open' group by 1,2),
ext_agg as (select extract(year from rd)::int y, extract(month from rd)::int m, sum(amt) prodex from (
    select (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then rr.date_check_out else rr.date_check_in end) rd,
           e.units*c.unit_price_gross amt
    from extras e join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value
    left join reservations rr on rr.company_id=e.company_id and rr.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid
    where e.company_id=(select cid from params) and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false)) z group by 1,2),
pax_agg as (select extract(year from rr.date_check_in)::int y, extract(month from rr.date_check_in)::int m, sum(rr.person_count) pax
  from reservations rr where rr.company_id=(select cid from params) and rr.status is distinct from 'Cancelled' group by 1,2),
mv as (select cap.y, cap.m,
     coalesce(n.bn,0)::numeric/nullif(cap.cap,0) occ, coalesce(n.bn,0) bn,
     n.prodacc/nullif(n.bn,0) adb, n.prodacc/nullif(cap.cap,0) revpab,
     coalesce(n.prodacc,0)+coalesce(ex.prodex,0) prod, coalesce(n.prodacc,0) prodacc, coalesce(ex.prodex,0) prodex,
     coalesce(n.res,0) res, coalesce(n.bn,0)::numeric/nullif(n.res,0) los, coalesce(px.pax,0) pax
  from cap_agg cap left join n_agg n using (y,m) left join ext_agg ex using (y,m) left join pax_agg px using (y,m)),
mvl as (select y,m,'occ' metric, occ val from mv union all select y,m,'bn', bn from mv union all select y,m,'adb', adb from mv union all select y,m,'revpab', revpab from mv union all select y,m,'prodtot', prod from mv union all select y,m,'prodacc', prodacc from mv union all select y,m,'prodex', prodex from mv union all select y,m,'resci', res from mv union all select y,m,'los', los from mv union all select y,m,'pax', pax from mv),
met as (select * from (values ('occ','% Ocupación','pct','avg',1,1),('bn','Bednights','int','sum',2,1),('adb','ADB','eur','avg',3,1),('revpab','RevPAB','eur','avg',4,0),('prodtot','Producción Total','keur','sum',5,1),('prodacc','Producción Aloj.','keur','sum',6,1),('prodex','Producción Extras','keur','sum',7,1),('resci','Reservas','int','sum',8,0),('los','LOS','dec','avg',9,0),('pax','Huéspedes','int','sum',10,0)) t(metric,label,fmt,agg,mo,tgt)),
lin as (select * from (values ('ytd','YTD',1,0),('lytd','LYTD',2,0),('delta','Δ YoY',3,0),('target','Target',4,1),('dtarget','Δ vs Target',5,1)) t(kind,line,lo,needtgt)),
cmm as (select metric, m, max(case when y=$CY then val end) cy, max(case when y=$LY then val end) ly from mvl where m<=11 group by metric, m),
agg as (select c.metric, me.agg ag, (case me.agg when 'sum' then sum(c.cy) else avg(c.cy) end) cya, (case me.agg when 'sum' then sum(c.ly) else avg(c.ly) end) lya from cmm c join met me on me.metric=c.metric group by c.metric, me.agg),
months as (select * from (values (1,'Ene'),(2,'Feb'),(3,'Mar'),(4,'Abr'),(5,'May'),(6,'Jun'),(7,'Jul'),(8,'Ago'),(9,'Sep'),(10,'Oct'),(11,'Nov')) t(mn,mlabel)),
body as (select me.label||' · '||li.line as row, mo.mlabel as col, mo.mn as "colOrd", (me.mo*10+li.lo) as roword,
    case li.kind when 'ytd' then c.cy when 'lytd' then c.ly when 'target' then c.cy*0.95
      when 'delta' then case when me.fmt='pct' then (c.cy-c.ly) else (c.cy-c.ly)/nullif(c.ly,0) end
      when 'dtarget' then case when me.fmt='pct' then (c.cy-c.cy*0.95) else (c.cy-c.cy*0.95)/nullif(c.cy*0.95,0) end end as v,
    case when li.kind in ('delta','dtarget') then (case when me.fmt='pct' then 'pp' else 'pct1' end) when me.fmt='pct' then 'pct1' else me.fmt end as fmt,
    (li.kind in ('delta','dtarget')) as arrow
  from met me cross join lin li cross join months mo left join cmm c on c.metric=me.metric and c.m=mo.mn
  where li.needtgt=0 or me.tgt=1),
tot as (select me.label||' · '||li.line as row, 'Total' as col, 99 as "colOrd", (me.mo*10+li.lo) as roword,
    case li.kind when 'ytd' then a.cya when 'lytd' then a.lya when 'target' then a.cya*0.95
      when 'delta' then case when me.fmt='pct' then (a.cya-a.lya) else (a.cya-a.lya)/nullif(a.lya,0) end
      when 'dtarget' then case when me.fmt='pct' then (a.cya-a.cya*0.95) else (a.cya-a.cya*0.95)/nullif(a.cya*0.95,0) end end as v,
    case when li.kind in ('delta','dtarget') then (case when me.fmt='pct' then 'pp' else 'pct1' end) when me.fmt='pct' then 'pct1' else me.fmt end as fmt,
    (li.kind in ('delta','dtarget')) as arrow
  from met me cross join lin li join agg a on a.metric=me.metric where li.needtgt=0 or me.tgt=1)
select row, col, "colOrd", round(v::numeric,6) v, fmt, arrow from (select * from body union all select * from tot) z
order by roword, "colOrd"
